summary: Neuraxis filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that its board authorized and declared a third-quarter 2026 stock dividend on its Series B Preferred Stock, payable in common stock. Holders receive shares based on accrued and unpaid dividends from July 1, 2026 through the record date divided by $2.38; roughly 81,339 shares are expected. Payable October 30, 2026, to holders of record October 26, 2026. Fractional shares are settled in cash at $2.38. This is a routine preferred dividend declaration, not a special situation; no deal, stake, or premium terms apply.
